messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - metering anomaly detected: token_count_delta > +10% in last 2h for region eu-west-1. Affected pipelines: ingestion-emitter-3, delta-agg. Severity: Sev2. Alert: https://redwood/alerts/INC-1765554320

alex (oncall): on it. grabbing initial metrics.

marisol (billing-eng): thanks, flagging billing team. customers could see overage flags.

alex (oncall): quick aggregate results: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM meter.emits WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now() - interval "2 hours";` returned ~1.12e9 vs baseline ~9.8e8 (~+14%).

jin (eng-runtime): seeing retries on emitter-host-7 around 22:10 UTC -> spikes to backend. snippet: ```
emit-retry host=emitter-7 status=503 retries=48
```

marisol (billing-eng): if writes are duplicating to ledger we should stop hard writes. can we enable shadow/write-only?

alex (oncall): feature flag `metering.shadow_write` available. opsbot can flip?

opsbot: @alex toggled `metering.shadow_write=true` in prod (ff-id=ff-9834). All incoming writes now go to shadow ledger only until cleared.

alex (oncall): confirmed. shadowing enabled. no hard ledger commits after 22:18 UTC.

billing-team: starting quick impact scan to list accounts with >2x token delta. putting top-10 in this thread in 5m.

support-ops: prepping customer comm draft. recommend "investigating anomalous token counts; billing adjustments paused while we reconcile" until we confirm.

marisol (billing-eng): mitigation suggestion: cordon emitter-7 and shift traffic to emitter-3/4 pool. jin can you cordon host?

jin (eng-runtime): `kubectl cordon emitter-7` -> done. draining pods and shifting traffic to emitter-3/4. Verified no new 5xx spikes on emitter-3/4.

alex (oncall): counts showing improvement: delta down from +14% to +2% over 12m. still seeing delayed usage reports for some accounts.

alex (oncall): running reconciliation backfill (dry-run): `python tools/backfill_usage.py --region eu-west-1 --since 2024-11-14T22:05Z --dry-run` -> dry-run estimates ~3M tokens pending distribution across affected windows.

marisol (billing-eng): hold customer-facing comm until backfill finishes and we have reconciliation results. we should also pause auto-overages for impacted window.

support-ops: drafted message: "We're investigating anomalous token reporting in EU. If you received overage alerts, we are pausing automated billing adjustments while we reconcile. We will follow up within 4 hours." Will post to status after billing sign-off.

alex (oncall): handing off to @linda (night oncall) in 30m. Runbook summary: shadow_write=true, emitter-7 cordoned, backfill job started (id=bf-1765), watching alert group INC-1765554320.

linda (oncall-NOC): acknowledged. please paste queries + next steps before handoff.

alex (oncall): pasted queries and backfill CLI in thread, pasted affected-accounts list (top10). logs:
```
2024-11-14T22:09:57Z emitter-7 emit-retry status=503 attempts=12
2024-11-14T22:11:02Z delta-agg flush window=22:05-22:10 size=1.9M tokens
```

marisol (billing-eng): creating JIRA INC-1765554320-BILL to track reconciliation + customer comm. tagging postmortem owners.

support-ops: ticket created and linked to incident thread. customer comm remains on hold.

jin (eng-runtime): root cause initial hypothesis: rate-limiter misconfig bump deployed at 22:04 caused bursty retries on emitter shard which triggered duplicate emits upstream. will roll a config fix across emitters (PR #4256).

marisol (billing-eng): postmortem notes: divergence window 22:05-22:34 UTC. recommendations: 1) add emitter queue qsize alert at 5k, 2) make `metering.shadow_write=true` default on auto for deploys, 3) add a reconciliation hold toggle for billing automation.

linda (oncall-NOC): taking over monitoring. will nudge billing-team at 23:15 UTC if backfill not complete. leaving this thread open. :white_check_mark:
